subprocess_flow.substep_name: Validate Architecture Baseline and Bill of Materials
subprocess_flow.description: The Data Centre Migration Requisition is reviewed against the approved Enterprise Infrastructure Architecture Blueprint, hardware compatibility matrix, and migration wave capacity forecasts. Sourcing specifications for compute, storage arrays, network switches, and HSMs are cross-referenced with pre-approved standard hardware models in ServiceNow HAM Product Catalog to eliminate rogue specifications and unauthorized architectural divergence.
inputs: Data Centre Migration Bill of Materials (BOM)
success_criteria: 100% of line items match pre-approved Enterprise Architecture hardware catalog models and capacity quotas.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify hardware requisitions align strictly with approved technical architecture standards and migration wave capacity plans.
subprocess_flow.scope: All physical servers, blade chassis, SAN storage nodes, core/leaf network fabrics, and security appliances for the migration.
triggers: Data Centre Migration Hardware Procurement Request submitted and approved in ServiceNow.
end_conditions: Hardware requisition passes automated catalog validation and technical architecture sign-off.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Ordering non-standard hardware configurations that fail enterprise architecture and operational resilience criteria.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated ServiceNow catalog enforcement blocking non-catalog items without formal Enterprise Architecture CCB approval.

change_management.change_request_process: Architecture deviations require an approved Standard Change or CCB technical variance exception.
change_management.versioning_rules: Hardware catalog item specifications versioned and locked in ServiceNow HAM Product Models.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Execute ERP Purchase Order Issuance and ServiceNow Integration
subprocess_flow.description: Upon technical architecture approval, the requisition is committed to the enterprise ERP system for financial approval and budget appropriation under capital expenditure rules. Once authorized, the ERP generates a binding Purchase Order (PO) and triggers an automated REST API/IntegrationHub sync back to ServiceNow HAM, establishing the central Purchase Order record.
dependencies: Validate Architecture Baseline and Bill of Materials
success_criteria: ServiceNow Purchase Order record is created with mapped cost codes, vendor IDs, line items, and quantities matching ERP.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Issue binding procurement orders through financial ERP and establish the master PO reference in ServiceNow.
subprocess_flow.scope: Procurement authorization and PO creation across authorized banking hardware suppliers.
end_conditions: PO issued to vendor and synchronized into ServiceNow HAM as an Approved Purchase Order.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Data discrepancy between ERP financial commitments and ServiceNow HAM purchase lines.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated bidirectional IntegrationHub reconciliation validating line-item integrity between ERP and ServiceNow.

change_management.change_request_process: Purchase order amendments route through financial ERP re-approval and propagate updates to ServiceNow PO lines.
change_management.versioning_rules: ServiceNow PO record version increments with timestamped audit entries on line updates.

subprocess_flow.description: Using the approved ServiceNow Purchase Order record, the ServiceNow HAM Pro Asset Procurement engine automatically generates individual pre-allocated asset stubs in the alm_hardware table for each purchased hardware unit. Each stub is assigned install_status='Ordered' (1) and substatus='Pending Delivery', linking back to the PO line item and initiating the cryptographic lifecycle record prior to delivery.
dependencies: Execute ERP Purchase Order Issuance and ServiceNow Integration
success_criteria: 100% of procured physical items possess a corresponding alm_hardware record with install_status='Ordered' and substatus='Pending Delivery'.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Establish early digital custody for all arriving physical hardware assets within the bank's ServiceNow HAM database.
subprocess_flow.scope: All serialized physical compute, storage, appliance, and switch equipment line items on the purchase order.
triggers: ServiceNow Purchase Order status updated to Approved.
end_conditions: All asset stubs created in alm_hardware and linked to respective PO line items.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Asset records omitted during procurement intake leading to untracked ghost assets.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated business rule generating asset stubs programmatically based on PO quantity counts, forbidding manual bypass.

change_management.change_request_process: Asset stub adjustments or line cancellation handled via standard PO line modification workflow.
change_management.versioning_rules: All alm_hardware record changes tracked in the ServiceNow audit log with user and sys_updated_on stamps.

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Ingest Supplier Advance Shipment Notification (ASN) Data
subprocess_flow.description: Hardware suppliers transmit electronic Advance Shipment Notifications (ASNs) via EDI/JSON data connectors prior to equipment dispatch. The ServiceNow HAM ASN Gateway ingests the payload, validates the data structure, and matches incoming vendor serial numbers, MAC addresses, port layouts, and component-level specifications directly into the pre-allocated alm_hardware stubs.
outputs: Pre-allocated alm_hardware Asset Staging Records with Expected Serial Numbers
success_criteria: 100% of vendor serial numbers and MAC addresses from the ASN successfully mapped to corresponding alm_hardware asset records prior to delivery.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Pre-populate authoritative manufacturer serial numbers and technical identifiers in ServiceNow before physical equipment ships.
subprocess_flow.scope: All inbound shipments dispatched from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) or authorized distribution channels.
end_conditions: All expected hardware serial numbers, MAC addresses, and shipping details populated in alm_hardware records.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Corrupt or mismatched serial numbers ingested from vendor ASN leading to reconciliation failures at goods intake.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated schema validation and duplicate serial check executed by ServiceNow Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE).

governance_requirements: Vendor SLA and Supply Chain Integrity Guidelines

change_management.change_request_process: ASN discrepancies trigger automated vendor notification tasks requiring vendor re-transmission.
change_management.versioning_rules: Raw ASN payloads archived in ServiceNow attachment sys_attachment table for audit reproducibility.

improvement_inputs: Supplier pre-shipment ASN accuracy reports and catalog standardization metrics

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Pre-Assign Data Centre Migration Rack Allocation and Power Reservation
subprocess_flow.description: Using Data Centre Infrastructure Management (DCIM) integrations and ServiceNow migration planning attributes, the pre-registered alm_hardware records are assigned target data centre site, cage, cabinet rack unit (RU) elevation, and dual power distribution unit (PDU) port feeds. The rack space reservation is locked to ensure physical capacity availability upon dock arrival and eliminate deployment delays.
inputs: Pre-allocated alm_hardware Asset Staging Records with Expected Serial Numbers
Data Centre Cabling Schedule and Elevation Plan
outputs: Pre-assigned Data Centre Migration Rack Allocation Reservation
Data Centre Staging Work Order Ready Token
dependencies: Ingest Supplier Advance Shipment Notification (ASN) Data
success_criteria: 100% of pre-allocated hardware assets are assigned validated target DC facility, cage, rack, and RU positions with power capacity confirmed.
subprocess_flow.purpose: Reserve physical cabinet space and power capacity in advance of delivery, ensuring zero rack contention during migration wave execution.
subprocess_flow.scope: Target primary and secondary migration data centre halls, cages, and high-density compute/network cabinets.
triggers: Successful population of vendor serial numbers and equipment dimensions in alm_hardware records.
end_conditions: Target rack space, elevation slot, and PDU feeds are reserved in ServiceNow alm_hardware location attributes and DCIM.
All ordered hardware items possess corresponding pre-allocated asset stubs in alm_hardware with serial numbers logged.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Cabinet space or power capacity exhaustion resulting from conflicting rack allocations across migration waves.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated DCIM integration check in ServiceNow validating rack elevation slot and dual-feed power availability before reserving.

governance_requirements: Data Centre Physical Cable and Rack Engineering Standards
FCA Operational Resilience Capacity Planning Baselines

change_management.change_request_process: Rack allocation modifications require a Change Task revision approved by the DC Migration Engineering Lead.
change_management.versioning_rules: Rack elevation schematics versioned in ServiceNow DCIM repository.
